svg.title: Twin flight: Ink-wash scroll
svg.desc: Twin flight (2D): a side-scrolling flight painted as an ink-wash handscroll. Aetherius, a dragon in a few brush strokes with Aeris on his back, rides a pale-blue current the player has drawn with the gift Turn the wind, past a dark crosswind gust; mountains fade into mist below. The ribbon at the top shows how far along the scroll the pair has flown toward the far peak, the ink rings mark scale hits taken, and the brush bar is the stamina left for wing beats.
